reviews.author: Nitin Vohra
reviews.body: Bracelet ka naam bilkul suit karta hai. Wrist par pehne ke baad rich aur premium appearance deta hai. ✨

reviews.author: Khushi Grover
reviews.body: Maine yeh bracelet gift kiya tha aur saamne wale ko bahut pasand aaya. Packaging itni premium thi ki alag se wrapping ki bhi zarurat nahi padi. 🎁

reviews.author: Avantika Vohra
reviews.body: Bracelet ki choti-choti detailing dekhkar quality ka andaza lag jata hai. Finish bahut smooth hai aur wrist par perfect fit deta hai.

sections.text:

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
Wear the Richie Rich Alpha Bracelet around your wrist as a daily crystal and sacred bead accessory.
Before wearing, hold the bracelet in your hand and set your intention for wealth, protection, confidence, grounding, and positive opportunities.
Wear it during daily work, business meetings, travel, office hours, festive occasions, meditation, or manifestation practices.
Let Pyrite support your wealth and success-focused intention, Black Obsidian support protection from negativity, and Karungali support grounding and spiritual strength.
You can wear it solo for a clean powerful look or pair it with a watch and other bracelets for a premium wrist style.
For best care, avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals.
After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store it separately in a pouch or jewellery box.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 A Symbol of Wealth, Protection & Grounded Prosperity Energy!

Bold, meaningful, and easy to style, the Richie Rich Alpha Bracelet is designed with a premium jewellery finish that gives it a powerful, luxurious, and statement-ready look. Its sleek bracelet structure makes it perfect for daily styling, while the wealth and protection-focused beads add a deeper intention to your everyday wear.

This wealth bracelet features a strong crystal and sacred bead combination:

→ Pyrite – Known as the Crystal of Wealth, traditionally linked with abundance, prosperity, confidence, success, and money-magnet energy.

→ Black Obsidian – Associated with nazar protection, grounding, emotional stability, and shielding from unwanted negativity.

→ Karungali – Traditionally associated with protection, grounding, spiritual strength, and keeping negative energy away.

A bracelet made not just for styling, but for wealth intention, protection energy, confidence, and grounded success.

Note: As crystals and beads are natural, slight variations in colour, size, texture, shine, and finish may occur.

Disclaimer: The Richie Rich Wealth Bracelet is designed to support prosperity intention, protection energy, grounding, and positive belief through mindful practice. Results may vary from person to person depending on mindset, lifestyle, actions, clarity, and personal effort. This product is not meant to guarantee wealth, success, or financial results.
